title: 特朗普：霍尔木兹海峡周五将完全开放
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: These strangers are not hunting for a couple of mines that they've already found.
segments.zh: 这些陌生人不是在搜寻他们已经找到的几枚水雷。

segments.en: But essentially ships are starting to go out.
segments.zh: 但基本上船只开始出航了。

segments.en: Now on Friday it'll be completely open.
We got all very well with Iran. It's a different set of leaders.
segments.zh: 我们与伊朗关系很好，只是换了不同的领导人。

segments.en: As you know, the first set is gone, the second set is gone.
segments.zh: 如你所知，第一任和第二任都走了。

segments.en: And we found the third set to be very smart.
segments.zh: 我们发现第三任非常聪明。

segments.en: Strong or smart, but we ended up making a deal.
segments.zh: 强势或聪明，但我们最终达成了协议。

segments.en: I felt badly that we had to go back on the attack for two nights.
segments.zh: 我很遗憾我们不得不连续两晚发动攻击。

segments.en: And I thought a third, but we made it before that happened.
segments.zh: 我以为会有第三晚，但在此之前我们就达成了协议。

segments.en: But I think a lot of great things are going to happen in the Middle East right now.
segments.zh: 但我认为中东即将发生许多伟大的事情。
